data_issues: No label problems found: label matches category on every train/val trial. Minor issues: train rows 14 and 92 are exact duplicates (same 30-neuron vector, both houses). The test set is distributionally shifted from train/val (a train-vs-test classifier reaches AUC ~0.95). Test rows reuse the same per-session trials many times, e.g. neuron 24 has count 39 in 6 test rows while its train max is 10, and there are fewer distinct values per neuron. This looks like the pseudo-population was resampled with replacement, which inflates the dependence between test rows. The decoder is also less confident on test than in CV.
